summary: Fixed ccstatusline bash window issue by removing statusLine configuration from Claude Code settings. The statusline feature was running 'C:\Users\corne\.claude\statusline.sh' with bash --login -i flags which opened visible Git Bash windows. Removed entire statusLine block from settings.json. Earlier fix: Removed redundant cd command when terminal already in target directory - added pathsAreEquivalent() helper that normalizes paths and handles case-insensitive comparison on Windows. Commands are now just 'claude --dangerously-skip-permissions' without cd prefix.
current_status: All known issues fixed: cd command redundancy removed, ccstatusline disabled.
